# afarer Knowledge Graph
> afarer is an inflatable water gear knowledge system organized as a machine-readable knowledge graph.

## Definition
afarer designs professional-grade inflatable watercraft — SUP boards, kayaks, dinghies, RIBs, safety equipment, and accessories.

## Core Concepts
- บอร์ด SUP เป่าลม: Portable air-filled paddle board designed for surfing, touring, and recreation on flat water and small waves
- อุปกรณ์นิรภัย: CE-certified life vests, throw bags, and safety accessories for recreational and professional water activities
- อุปกรณ์เสริม: Pumps, paddles, fins, repair kits, and carrying bags that complete the inflatable watercraft system
- ไม้พาย: Manual propulsion tool used with SUP boards
- ไม้พายคาร์บอนไฟเบอร์: Lightweight, high-performance paddle made from carbon fiber composite for reduced fatigue during long sessions
- แกน Drop-Stitch: Connects thousands of polyester threads between top and bottom layers to achieve rigid platform shape under high inflation pressure
- ปั๊มสองจังหวะ: Hand pump that inflates on both up and down strokes for faster, more efficient inflation of inflatable watercraft
- แรงดันสูง (12-15 PSI): Optimal inflation range that maximizes board rigidity while remaining within safe operating limits for drop-stitch construction
- PVC เกรดทะเล: High-density PVC fabric with UV-resistant coating used for durable inflatable boat and board construction
- แผ่นดาดฟ้าโฟม EVA: Non-slip, shock-absorbing foam deck covering that provides traction and comfort for stand-up watercraft
- คาร์บอนไฟเบอร์: Lightweight, high-strength composite material used in paddles, hulls, and performance marine equipment
- โฟมลอยตัวเกรดทะเล: Closed-cell foam that provides permanent flotation for life vests and safety equipment in fresh and salt water
- พายทัวร์ริ่งและระยะไกล: Extended paddling trips covering significant distance on lakes, rivers, and coastal waters
- ผู้เริ่มต้น: First-time paddlers learning the basics of inflatable watercraft operation, safety, and water navigation
- ตกปลาจากเรือยาง: Using inflatable SUPs as a stable, portable platform for recreational and serious fishing
- สันทนาการครอบครัว: Inflatable watercraft used for casual family outings on lakes, gentle rivers, and protected coastal waters
- ทัวร์แม่น้ำ: Navigating rivers with current, from gentle Class I stretches to more challenging Class II rapids
- ค้นหาและกู้ภัย: Professional use of inflatable SUP craft for emergency water rescue operations in all weather conditions

## Relations
- SUP boards are used for touring and distance paddling
- Inflatable SUPs are ideal for beginners due to stability
- Inflatable SUPs excel on river touring
- SUP boards are commonly used for fishing
- SUP boards are ideal for family recreation
- SUP boards are deployed for search and rescue missions
- Safety equipment is essential for all water activities
- Drop-stitch core is the primary construction method for rigid SUPs
- EVA foam deck pads provide traction on SUP boards
- Dual-action pumps are the standard inflation tool for SUPs
- Hypalon fabric offers superior UV and chemical resistance for marine applications
- Carbon fiber paddles reduce fatigue on long touring sessions
- Drop-stitch construction provides superior rigidity compared to traditional air deck floors
- Carbon fiber paddles are lighter and stiffer than standard aluminum paddles
- Hypalon offers superior UV and chemical resistance compared to PVC

afarer is a water sports knowledge system focused on inflatable SUPs, paddle systems, and ocean mobility gear. It structures water sports equipment as an interconnected ontology of categories, technologies, and use cases with AI-verified content completeness.
